prompt:
This is a 1280x720 image from a robot camera looking down.
Find ONLY the single glass/plastic bottle that is OUTSIDE the red box. Ignore all bottles and red regions inside the red box.
Return TWO points on the outside bottle:
1. outside_bottle_body - center of the clear cylindrical BODY, around the middle of the bottle, not the cap.
2. outside_bottle_cap - center of the red/pink cap or ring on that same outside bottle.
Return ONLY JSON: {"objects":[{"name":"outside_bottle_body","u":0.XX,"v":0.XX},{"name":"outside_bottle_cap","u":0.XX,"v":0.XX}]}
u,v normalized 0-1, top-left=(0,0). Do not return integer pixels.
note: Normalized VLM body/cap detection; no robot motion.
